Draws a frame of an image without any transparency, so the mask color is drawn like any other. It is faster than [DrawImage](DrawImage) for pictures that fill a rectangle completely, such as backgrounds.

```blitzbasic
;media still images/drawblock.png
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local img = CreateImage(100, 100)
SetBuffer ImageBuffer(img)
Color 255, 160, 0
Oval 5, 5, 90, 90, 1
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
Color 40, 90, 160
Rect 0, 0, 320, 240, 1
DrawImage img, 30, 70
DrawBlock img, 190, 70
Color 255, 255, 255
Text 80, 200, "DrawImage", 1, 1
Text 240, 200, "DrawBlock", 1, 1
Flip
WaitKey
```

![DrawBlock](media/images/drawblock.png)
@param image  The image to draw.
@param x      Horizontal position of the handle of the image.
@param y      Vertical position of the handle of the image.
@param frame  Which frame to draw. Defaults to 0.
